meta.era: DAoC patch 1.65 (to 2003-10-08), Classic + Shrouded Isles, no Catacombs/ToA classes; Sluaghbinder excluded
notes: Build spec points come from dated 2002-2003 forum posts (FreddysHouse, European GOA servers). weight is an estimate informed by forumMentions; weightSourced=false everywhere.
forumMentions = number of dated posts (to 2003-10-08) in the 1,483 spec/template threads crawled whose top two spec lines match this build within 4 points.
use: rvr = mostly seen at 50 in RvR; levelling = mostly a levelling/PvE build; both.
Spec line names follow DOL.GS.Specs constants in the repo (e.g. Cold Magic, Wind Magic, Longbows, Polearm, Recurve Bow, Composite Bow).
